title: Payment Protection Monthly Fee Schedule
content:
Payment Protection is priced as a monthly fee per 1,000 USD of the loan's unpaid principal. The rate depends on the plan.

## Schedule of rates

| Plan | Monthly fee per 1,000 USD of unpaid principal |
|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | USD 0.35 |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | USD 0.95 |
| Payment Protection Complete | USD 1.65 |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | USD 0.60 |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | USD 1.65 |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | USD 2.80 |

## Charging terms

The following terms are identical for all six plans (Payment Protection Life, Payment Protection Life and Disability, Payment Protection Complete, Joint Payment Protection Life, Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability and Joint Payment Protection Complete).

| Term | Value for every plan |
|---|---|
| Balance the monthly fee is computed on | unpaid principal on the loan due date the fee is charged |
| When the fee is charged | on each loan due date, for the coverage month that starts on that due date; collected with the installment |
| Rounding of the monthly fee | to the cent, half up |
| Fee in a coverage month in which a benefit is paid | no fee is charged for that coverage month |
| Largest unpaid principal a plan covers | USD 50000.00; principal above it is not cancelled or counted for fees |

## Schedule notes

1. Rates are quoted per 1,000 USD of unpaid principal, not per 1,000 USD of the original loan amount.
2. Payment Protection Complete and Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability carry the same rate, USD 1.65.
3. Each due date opens one coverage month, and the fee for that month is charged on that due date and collected with that installment.
4. Principal above USD 50000.00 is not counted for fees: on a hypothetical loan with an unpaid principal of USD 64,000.00 on the due date, only USD 50000.00 counts for the fee.
